reason: This plugin is primarily a conversation-memory management tool for DeepSeek Harness that lets users delete one completed turn from a session without deleting the session itself; evidence in the README describes UI-facing turn actions, protected execution conditions, and durable replacement-event handling, so classification is centered on turn-level context cleanup rather than general automation or workflow orchestration.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 插件，用于在会话中对已完成的单个回合进行删除操作，保留会话与后续上下文，仅清除该回合在模型可见面的内容。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness web plugin that lets users delete one completed turn from a session while keeping the session and later context, clearing that turn from the model-visible chat surface.

capabilities: Removes the model-visible prompt/assistant/tool content for a completed conversation turn
Adds a tombstone replacement event while keeping the original append-only session event history
Injects a web UI action into conversation controls for turn deletion
Calls a host-side turn-deletion endpoint and flushes session state

reasons.code: Readme states turn deletion is available as a trash action on completed ordinary turns with confirmation and is disabled while a session is running
Readme states the action removes prompt, assistant, and tool content for the selected turn while keeping session id, title, workspace association, and later turns
Readme states deletion writes a durable zero-content replacement and persists via flush so it remains after reload/restart
Design section documents a host POST endpoint handling turn deletion and session flush acknowledgment
